title: Vriesea hieroglyphica
wikitext:
{{Short description|Species of flowering plant}} {{Speciesbox |image = Vriesea hieroglyphica (6225126171).jpg |genus = Vriesea |species = hieroglyphica |authority = ([[Élie-Abel Carrière|Carrière]]) [[Charles Jacques Édouard Morren|É.Morren]] }} '''''Vriesea hieroglyphica''''' is a plant [[species]] in the genus ''[[Vriesea]]''. The name refers to the linear horizontal patterns on the leaves that resemble [[hieroglyph]]s. It has been nicknamed "King of the bromeliads."{{cite book|last=Padilla|first=Victoria|title=Bromeliads|year=1973|publisher=Crown Publishers|location=New York|isbn=0517562413|pages=[https://archive.org/details/bromeliads00vict/page/104 104]|url=https://archive.org/details/bromeliads00vict/page/104}} ==Distribution== This [[bromeliad]] species is [[Endemism|endemic]] to southeastern [[Brazil]]. It grows at low altitudes in humid conditions under the shade of trees in the [[Atlantic Forest|Atlantic Forest biome]] (''Mata Atlantica Brasileira'').{{cite journal |last1=Martinelli |first1=Gustavo |last2=Vieira |first2=Cláudia Magalhães |last3=Gonzalez |first3=Marcos |last4=Leitman |first4=Paula |last5=Piratininga |first5=Andréa |last6=Costa |first6=Andrea Ferreira da |last7=Forzza |first7=Rafaela Campostrini |title=Bromeliaceae da Mata Atlântica Brasileira: lista de espécies, distribuição e conservação |journal=Rodriguésia |date=January 2008 |volume=59 |issue=1 |pages=209–258 |jstor=23499386 |doi=10.1590/2175-7860200859114 |trans-title=Bromeliaceae of the brazilian Atlantic Forest: checklist, distribution and conservation |language=pt-BR|doi-access=free }} ==Description== ''Vriesea hieroglyphica'' develops green leaves with irregular dark cross banding and recurved tips. The plant develops 30-40 shiny, bright green leaves measuring {{convert|3|ft|m}} long and 3 inches wide. It typically blooms in spring, and can bloom repeatedly in cultivation, with branching yellow, cream, or white flowers on a tall branched spike. The tall, light green flower spike "bears a branched inflorescence with 1-inch-long, pale green bracts and dull yellow-petaled flowers." {{cite book|last=Padilla|first=Victoria|title=Bromeliads|year=1973|publisher=Crown Publishers|location=New York|isbn=0517562413|pages=[https://archive.org/details/bromeliads00vict/page/104 104]|url=https://archive.org/details/bromeliads00vict/page/104}} The [[variety (biology)|variety]] ''Vriesea hieroglyphica'' var. ''Marginata'' has broad cream−ivory colored bands on the leaves. ==Cultivation== The distinctive leaf markings make ''Vriesea hieroglyphica'' a popular [[ornamental plant]] cultivated for [[gardening]] and commercial floristry uses, including as an interior landscape−[[house plant]]s, potted outdoor plants, and planted in [[garden]]s in suitable climates.{{cite book|last=Rauh|first=Werner|title=Bromeliads For Home, Garden and Greenhouses|year=1979|publisher=Nlandford Press Ltd.|isbn=071370845X|pages=349}} Outdoors it can be grown from light to full shade, and is rated for [[USDA Zone]] 10 (min 30 °F) and up. Indoors, it is usually grown with a northern exposure and assured humidity.{{cite book|last=Kramer|first=Jack|title=Bromeliads The Colorful House Plants|year=1976|publisher=Litton Educational Publishing, Inc.|isbn=0-442-24518-1|pages=90; 100}} ===Cultivars and hybrids=== [[File:Vriesea hieroglyphica kz1.JPG|thumb|250px|Cultivated plants blooming in the ''Jardín de Aclimatación de La Orotava'', [[Tenerife]].]] [[File:Vriesea Hieroglyphica pot.jpg|thumb|250px|''Vriesea hieroglyphica'' grown in garden pots.]] Garden [[cultivar]]s of ''Vriesea hieroglyphica'', and [[hybrid (biology)|hybrid]]s with other ''Vriesea'' species, include:[http://www.bsi.org/brom_info/cultivar/bcr.html BSI Cultivar Registry: ''Vriesea hieroglyphica'' cultivars and hybrids] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091202073716/http://www.bsi.org/brom_info/cultivar/bcr.html |date=2009-12-02 }} . retrieved 11 October 2009. {{colbegin|colwidth=26em}} * ''Vriesea'' 'After Glow' * [[Vriesea 'El Supremo'|''Vriesea'' 'El Supremo']] * [[Vriesea 'Elvira'|''Vriesea'' 'Elvira']] * ''Vriesea'' 'Gigant Jade' * [[Vriesea 'Glossy Girl'|''Vriesea'' 'Glossy Girl']] * ''Vriesea'' 'Grand Purple' * ''Vriesea'' 'Hawaiian Sunrise' * ''Vriesea'' 'Intermedia' * ''Vriesea'' 'Jungle Jade' * [[Vriesea 'Leverett's Delight'|''Vriesea'' 'Leverett's Delight']] *''Vriesea'' 'Machu Picchu' * ''Vriesea'' 'Madame Morobe' * ''Vriesea'' 'Maureen' * ''Vriesea'' 'Montezuma's Gem' * [[Vriesea 'Pamela Leaver'|''Vriesea'' 'Pamela Leaver']] * ''Vriesea'' 'Patrice' * ''Vriesea'' 'Shizuko Murakami' * ''Vriesea'' 'Yellow Wave' * [[Vriesea 'You Beaut'|''Vriesea'' 'You Beaut']] {{colend|colwidth=26em}} ==References== {{Reflist|26em}} ==External links== *[http://davesgarden.com/guides/pf/go/102871/#b Dave's Garden Blog: ''Vriesea hieroglyphica'' − King of the Bromeliads] — ''horticulture info + images''. {{Commons category|position=left|Vriesea hieroglyphica|
